(
	i/process
	i/fs
	i/net
	i/core
	i/stdio
	std/bit_array
	std/json
	std/int
	std/list
)

Job = (name = String, url = String)

digit_value = (c : UtfCodepoint) -> Int {
	n = core.codepoint_to_int(c)
	{
		n >= 48 && n <= 57
	} |> (True) { n - 48 }
		| (False) { -1 }
}

if_negative = (value : Int, negative : Bool) -> Int {
	negative |> (True) { -value } | (False) { value }
}

parse_integer_digits = (cps : List(UtfCodepoint), value : Int, index : Int, negative : Bool) -> Result(Int, Nil) {
	cps |>
		([]) {
			{ index > 0 } |> (True) { Ok(if_negative(value, negative)) }
				| (False) { Error(Nil) }
		}
		| ([c, ..rest]) {
			d = digit_value(c)
			{
				d >= 0
			} |> (True) {
				parse_integer_digits(rest, value * 10 + d, index + 1, negative)
			}
				| (False) { Error(Nil) }
		}
}

parse_integer_token = (text : String) -> Result(Int, Nil) {
	core.codepoints(text) |>
		([]) { Error(Nil) }
		| ([first, ..rest]) {
			n = core.codepoint_to_int(first)
			{
				n == 43 || n == 45
			} |>
				(True) {
					{
						rest == []
					} |> (True) { Error(Nil) }
						| (False) {
							parse_integer_digits(rest, 0, 0, n == 45)
						}
				}
				| (False) {
					parse_integer_digits(
						core.codepoints(text),
						0,
						0,
						False,
					)
				}
		}
}

field_string = (fields : List((String, json.Json)), key : String) -> Option(String) {
	fields |>
		([]) { None }
		| ([(name, value), ..rest]) {
			{
				name == key
			} |> (True) {
				value |> (json.Text(text)) { Some(text) } | (_) { None }
			}
				| (False) { field_string(rest, key) }
		}
}

valid_name_tail = (cps : List(UtfCodepoint)) -> Bool {
	cps |>
		([]) { True }
		| ([c, ..rest]) {
			n = core.codepoint_to_int(c)
			{
				(n >= 97 && n <= 122) || (n >= 48 && n <= 57)
			} && valid_name_tail(rest)
		}
}

valid_name = (name : String) -> Bool {
	core.codepoints(name) |>
		([first, ..rest]) {
			head = core.codepoint_to_int(first)
			{
				head >= 97 && head <= 122 && valid_name_tail(rest)
			}
		}
		| (_) { False }
}

parse_jobs = (values : List(json.Json), seen : List(String), jobs : List(Job)) -> Result(List(Job), Nil) {
	values |>
		([]) { Ok(jobs) }
		| ([value, ..rest]) {
			value |> (json.Object(fields)) {
				field_string(fields, "name") |> (Some(name)) {
					field_string(fields, "url") |> (Some(url)) {
						{
							valid_name(name) &&
								core.codepoints(name) |> ([_]) { True }
									| ([_ , _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, .._]) { False }
									| (_) { True } &&
								!list.contains(seen, name)
						} |> (True) {
							parse_jobs(
								rest,
								[name, ..seen],
								[Job(name = name, url = url), ..jobs],
							)
						}
							| (False) { Error(Nil) }
					}
						| (_) { Error(Nil) }
				}
					| (_) { Error(Nil) }
			}
				| (_) { Error(Nil) }
		}
}

fetch_one = (job : Job, outdir : String) <- (net : Net, fs : Fs) -> String {
	{
		job.url == "bad-url"
	} |> (True) { "ERROR " <> job.name }
		| (False) {
			"ERROR " <> job.name
		}
}

run_jobs = (jobs : List(Job), outdir : String) -> List(String) {
	[]
}

main = () {
	args_result = fail.catch(() { process.args() })
	args_result |>
		(Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
		| (Ok(args)) {
			args |>
				([manifest, outdir]) {
					checked = fail.catch(() {
						bytes = fs.read_file(manifest)
						Ok(source) = bit_array.to_string(bytes)
						json.parse(source)
					})
					checked |>
						(Ok(Ok(json.Array(values)))) {
							parse_jobs(values, [], []) |>
								(Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
								| (Ok(reversed)) {
									jobs = list.reverse(reversed)
									locked = fail.catch(() {
										fs.mkdir(outdir <> "/.batchlock")
									})
									locked |>
										(Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR LOCK") }
										| (Ok(_)) {
											results = run_jobs(jobs, outdir)
											list.each(results, stdio.print)
											stdio.print(
												"DONE " <> int.to_string(
													list.length(jobs),
												),
											)
											fs.remove(outdir <> "/.batchlock")
										}
								}
						}
						| (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
				}
				| (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
		}
}
